units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 5. Persons responsible for disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by a citizen, servant or employee under parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article, or for using that information for purposes not provided for by federal laws, are liable in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 6. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article, except information submitted by state civil servants and citizens applying for inclusion in the federal personnel reserve of the state civil service of the Russian Federation, citizens applying for positions as heads of state (municipal) institutions, financial ombudsmen or head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities, and persons holding those positions, is carried out by decision of the employer’s representative (head) or a person authorized by that representative (head), according to the procedure established by the President of the Russian Federation, either independently or by requesting from federal executive bodies authorized to conduct operational-search activities the information they hold on the income, property and property-related obligations of citizens or persons specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article and of those citizens’ or persons’ spouses and minor children.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7.1. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by citizens applying for positions as heads of state (municipal) institutions and by persons holding those positions is carried out by decision of the founder or a person authorized by the founder, according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation. The powers to send requests to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation, other federal state bodies, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, territorial bodies of federal executive bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations to verify the accuracy and completeness of information on those persons’ income, property and property-related obligations are determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7.1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7.2. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by a citizen applying for the position of Chief Financial Ombudsman and by a person holding that position is carried out according to the procedure established by the President of the Russian Federation. The powers to send requests to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation, other federal state bodies, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, territorial bodies of federal executive bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations to verify the accuracy and completeness of information on that citizen’s and that person’s income, property and property-related obligations are determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7.2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7.3. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by citizens applying for positions as financial ombudsmen in financial services sectors or head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities, and by persons holding those positions, is carried out by decision of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by its normative acts.
units.label: Part 7.3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7.4. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by state civil servants and citizens applying for inclusion in the federal personnel reserve of the state civil service of the Russian Federation is carried out according to the procedure established by the President of the Russian Federation. The powers to send requests to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation, other federal state bodies, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, territorial bodies of federal executive bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations to verify the accuracy and completeness of information on those persons’ income, property and property-related obligations are determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7.4 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 8. Failure by a citizen, upon entry into state or municipal service, employment with the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation, another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, or appointment as financial ombudsman, head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities or head of a state (municipal) institution, to submit to the employer’s representative (employer) information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouse and minor children, submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information is grounds for refusing that citizen admission to state or municipal service, employment with the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation, another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, or appointment as financial ombudsman, head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities or head of a state (municipal) institution.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 9. Failure by a citizen or person specified in part 1 of this Article to fulfill the duty provided for by part 1 of this Article constitutes an offense resulting in removal from the position held, including the positions of financial ombudsman or head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities, dismissal from state or municipal service, dismissal from employment with the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation or another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, dismissal from employment with an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, or a state (municipal) institution.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 10. For the purposes of this Federal Law, digital currency is recognized as property.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.text: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.label: Art. 8.1

units.locator: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.text: 1. Persons holding positions included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation or normative acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation are obliged to submit information on their expenditure and on the expenditure of their spouses and minor children in the cases and according to the procedure established by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and normative acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8.1

units.locator: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.text: 2. Monitoring the correspondence between the expenditure of persons specified in part 1 of this Article and their spouses and minor children and the aggregate income of persons specified in part 1 of this Article, their spouses and minor children for the three years immediately preceding the transaction is carried out according to the procedure provided for by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and normative acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8.1

units.locator: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.text: 3. Where submission of information is mandatory, failure by persons specified in part 1 of this Article to submit information on their expenditure, submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information on their expenditure, or failure to submit information on the expenditure of their spouses and minor children, submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information on the expenditure of their spouses and minor children constitutes an offense resulting in the removal of persons specified in part 1 of this Article from the positions they hold, including the positions of financial ombudsman or head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities, or their dismissal according to the established procedure from state or municipal service, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, employment with a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation, another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8.1

units.locator: Article 8.1. Submission of Information on Expenditure
units.text: 4. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 8.1

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.label: Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 1. If verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations reveals that, during the year preceding the year of submission of that information (the reporting period), funds were credited to accounts of the person who submitted the information (hereinafter referred to as the person under verification), the person’s spouse and minor children with banks and/or other credit institutions in an amount exceeding their aggregate income for the reporting period and the two preceding years, the persons conducting the verification are obliged to require the person under verification to provide information confirming the lawful receipt of those funds.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 2. If the person under verification fails to provide information confirming the lawful receipt of those funds, or provides inaccurate information, the person who decided to conduct the verification shall forward its materials to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation within three days after its completion.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 3. If the person under verification is dismissed (their powers are terminated) before completion of the verification specified in part 1 of this Article, and there is information that, during the reporting period, funds were credited to accounts of that person, the person’s spouse and minor children with banks and/or other credit institutions in an amount exceeding their aggregate income for the reporting period and the two preceding years, the person who decided to conduct the verification shall forward its materials to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation within three days after the person’s dismissal (termination of powers).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 4. No later than 10 working days after receiving the materials specified in part 3 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall decide, separately for each person under verification, to verify the lawful receipt of the funds specified in part 3 of this Article. The decision is made in writing.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 5. No later than two working days after the decision specified in part 4 of this Article is made, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors are obliged to notify the person under verification in writing of the decision concerning them and of the need to provide information confirming the lawful receipt of the funds specified in part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 6. The verification specified in part 4 of this Article is conducted by prosecutors.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 7. The verification specified in part 4 of this Article may not be conducted after six months have elapsed from the dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 8. During the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the person under verification is entitled to:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 1) provide written explanations of the sources of funds credited to their accounts and the accounts of their spouse and minor children with banks and/or other credit institutions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 2) submit additional materials and provide written explanations of them;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 3) request an interview with the prosecutor on matters connected with the verification. The request must be granted.
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 9. When conducting the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors are obliged to:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 1) require the person under verification to provide information confirming the lawful receipt of the funds specified in part 3 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 2) examine additional materials submitted by the person under verification;
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 3) interview the person under verification upon receipt of the request provided for by point 3 of part 8 of this Article.
units.label: Point 3 Part 9 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 10. When conducting the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors are entitled to:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 1) interview the person under verification on their own initiative;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 2) obtain explanations from the person under verification concerning the information and materials submitted by that person;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 3) send requests, according to the established procedure, to federal state bodies, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations for information they hold on the income, property and property-related obligations of the person under verification, the person’s spouse and minor children, and on the sources of funds credited to their accounts with banks and/or other credit institutions. Requests to credit institutions, tax authorities of the Russian Federation, bodies responsible for state registration of rights to immovable property and transactions involving it, operators of information systems in which digital financial assets are issued, and the authorized body responsible for countering the legalization (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism, extremist activity, and the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction are sent by the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation, Deputy Prosecutors General of the Russian Federation, prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and military and other specialized prosecutors equivalent in status to prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 4) make inquiries of individuals and obtain information from them with their consent.
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 11. Heads of state bodies, local self-government bodies and organizations who receive a request specified in point 3 of part 10 of this Article are obliged to arrange for its execution in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and provide the requested information according to the established procedure.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 12. The procedure for considering the materials of the verification specified in part 4 of this Article is determined by the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 13. After completing the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall inform the person who forwarded materials to prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation under part 3 of this Article of the results.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 14. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors who receive the materials specified in part 2 of this Article shall consider them within their competence established by the Federal Law ‘On the Prosecutor’s Office of the Russian Federation’ and, no later than four months after receiving them, where grounds exist, apply to a court according to civil procedure legislation to recover for the revenue of the Russian Federation a sum equivalent to the portion of the funds specified in part 1 of this Article for which reliable information confirming lawful receipt has not been obtained, if the amount to be recovered exceeds ten thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 15. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall consider the materials of the verification specified in part 4 of this Article and, no later than one month after its completion, where grounds exist, apply to a court according to civil procedure legislation to recover for the revenue of the Russian Federation a sum equivalent to the portion of the funds specified in part 3 of this Article for which information confirming lawful receipt has not been submitted, if the amount to be recovered exceeds ten thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 16. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall send information on the results of the courts’ consideration of the applications specified in parts 14 and 15 of this Article to the public authority or organization in which the person subject to the verifications specified in parts 1 and 4 of this Article holds or held a position.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.2. Monitoring the Lawfulness of the Receipt of Funds
units.text: 17. The procedure for sending the information specified in part 16 of this Article is determined by the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 8.2

units.locator: Article 8.3. Analysis of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: Article 8.3. Analysis of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.label: Art. 8.3

units.locator: Article 8.3. Analysis of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: Units for prevention of corruption and other offenses (officials responsible for preventing corruption and other offenses) in public authorities, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, and bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation responsible for preventing corruption and other offenses, are obliged to analyze information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Federal Law.
units.label: Art. 8.3 · text

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: 1. A state or municipal servant is obliged to notify the employer’s representative (employer), prosecution bodies or other state bodies of every instance in which any person approaches the servant with the aim of inducing a corruption offense.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: 2. Reporting approaches intended to induce corruption offenses is an official (service) duty of a state or municipal servant, except where the facts concerned have been or are being verified.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: 3. Failure by a state or municipal servant to perform the official (service) duty provided for by part 1 of this Article constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from state or municipal service or other forms of liability in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: 4. A state or municipal servant who has notified the employer’s representative (employer), prosecution bodies or other state bodies of approaches intended to induce the servant to commit a corruption offense, of corruption offenses committed by other state or municipal servants, of failure to submit information, of submission of knowingly incomplete information except in cases established by federal laws, or of submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations, is under state protection in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Duty of State and Municipal Servants to Report Approaches Intended to Induce Corruption Offenses
units.text: 5. The procedure for notifying the employer’s representative (employer) of approaches intended to induce a state or municipal servant to commit corruption offenses, the list of information to be included in notifications, the organization of verification of that information, and the procedure for registering notifications are determined by the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 5 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Federal Law, a conflict of interest means a situation in which the personal interest (direct or indirect) of a person holding a position that entails a duty to take measures to prevent and resolve conflicts of interest affects or may affect the proper, objective and impartial performance of that person’s official (service) duties (exercise of powers).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 2. In part 1 of this Article, personal interest means the possibility that the person specified in part 1 of this Article and/or persons closely related to that person by blood or marriage (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and also the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and the spouses of children), or citizens or organizations with which the person specified in part 1 of this Article and/or persons closely related to that person by blood or marriage have property, corporate or other close relations, may receive income in the form of money, other property, including property rights, services of a property nature, results of work performed, or any benefits (advantages).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 3. The duty to take measures to prevent and resolve conflicts of interest is imposed on:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 1) state and municipal servants;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 2) employees of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, employees holding positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, and persons holding the positions of Financial Ombudsman or head of the service supporting the activities of the Financial Ombudsman;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 3) employees holding certain positions included in lists established by federal state bodies under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Conflict of Interest
units.text: 4) other categories of persons in cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 1. A person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law shall take measures to preclude any possibility of a conflict of interest arising.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 2. A person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law shall notify the employer’s representative (employer) or another authorized person designated by this Federal Law, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation or regulatory acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation of a conflict of interest that has arisen or the possibility of one arising as soon as the person becomes aware of it, according to the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative, employer or other authorized person specified in part 2 of this Article, upon learning that a person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law has a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, shall take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Procedure for Preventing and Resolving Conflicts of Interest
units.text: 4. Preventing or resolving a conflict of interest may consist in changing the official or service status of the person specified in part 1 of Article 10 of this Federal Law who is a party to the conflict of interest, up to and including suspension from the performance of official (service) duties according to the established procedure, and/or in that person relinquishing the benefit that gave rise to the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11
